name: comp-144
title: Card Checkbox Border
blurb: Checkbox inside a bordered card that highlights on selection.
description: Checkbox card with border that changes to primary color when checked. Full card is clickable via pseudo-element. Includes label and description.
use_when: Card-based selections in galleries or option pickers.
avoid_when: Simple form fields—this is a premium presentation.
a11y: Checkbox properly labeled and described. Card border changes indicate state. Full keyboard support with focus ring.
